name: Circle
tagline: Circle is a community platform that lets creators and brands run discussions, events, courses, and direct messaging under one roof instead of a branded website. Built-in AI helps draft welcome posts, summarize long threads, and flag content that needs a moderator, so community managers spend less time on upkeep and more time on members.
